explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/274 posed in the 'yes' direction: there is a nontrivial group with an exact covering by more than one coset of subgroups of pairwise different sizes. The conjectured answer is no, and the question tag signals that this is a yes/no question. Using cardinality is fine. In a finite coset partition every subgroup has finite index (Neumann), so in an infinite group all parts have the same cardinality, and only finite groups could be witnesses.
